name: og-02-alt-reaction-universe
title: The Open Network: Do Autocatalytic Motifs Emerge From Rule-Generated Chemistry, Beyond Chance?
question: Model Upgrade plan, Phase 3. og-02 showed a hand-curated rTCA fragment persists and self-amplifies under flow — but its autocatalytic turn (OAA + 2 CO2 -> 2 OAA + acetate) was written into the network. If the network is instead GENERATED from a Wolos-2020-style rule set over C1-C3 feedstock with real eQuilibrator thermodynamics, catalyst limits and degradation, and fed the Phase-1 posterior vent state, do persistent autocatalytic subnetworks appear at all, are they more frequent than in matched null networks, and how does the curated rTCA class compare when all three are graded by one post-hoc detector and one element / free-energy ledger?
hypothesis: Under the Phase-1 posterior feed (CO2 1.4 mM, H2 10.8 mM, pyruvate 0.1 mM) the generated universe sustains a connected multi-species network but no autocatalytic motif (the C1 -> C2 bottleneck is thermodynamic at vent concentrations); supplying the formose feedstock (formaldehyde) lets a motif emerge from the rules and that motif count is enriched relative to degree-preserving, carbon/oxygen-matched nulls; the curated class's motif is detected but imposed and its stoichiometry fails the element ledger.
objective: Build the proto_metabolism face (curated_rtca | reaction_universe | null_network), the vg-data package reaction_universe (rules, eQuilibrator dG', catalyst requirements), the NetworkLedgerProcess (exact element residual, integrated carbon balance, dissipation >= 0) and a class-agnostic post-hoc motif detector; run the three classes under two feeds (Phase-1 posterior; + 10 mM formaldehyde) with 24 matched nulls per arm, an ignition map, flux-control analysis and a stiffness check.
claim: With real thermodynamics and conservation, autocatalysis is not free: the generated universe fed the Phase-1 vent posterior builds a persistent, element-balanced, dissipative network but no autocatalytic motif, because every C-C-forming route is uphill at vent concentrations; the one motif that does emerge — the formose cycle, recovered post hoc from the rules, absent in every matched null — needs a formaldehyde supply the vent chemistry does not make and a residence time shorter than its reductive destruction. The curated rTCA result survives as one class among three, with its motif now classed as imposed and its stoichiometry flagged as non-conserving.

findings.statement: At the Phase-1 posterior feed the rule-generated universe (121 species, 413 reversible reactions, C <= 4) sustains 14 persistent species and a net CO2 fixation of 2.2e-5 mol/s but contains NO persistent autocatalytic motif (0 flux-carrying simple cycles with gain > 1); all 24 matched nulls also contain 0. The rTCA reductive branch pyruvate -> OAA -> malate -> succinate appears from the rules at 5e-8 / 9e-8 / 8e-9 M — three orders below og-02's curated 2 mM OAA — because pyruvate carboxylation at 1.4 mM CO2 sits at its equilibrium (dG'0 = -1.1 kJ/mol -> [OAA]/[pyruvate] = K [CO2] = 2e-3) rather than being driven irreversibly.

evidence.observed: universe 0 motifs, 14 persistent species, malate 8.8e-8 M; nulls 0/24; p = 1.0

findings.explanation: Every C-C bond-forming route is uphill at vent concentrations: reductive carboxylation of formate / acetate (+7.7 / +30.6 kJ/mol standard, +50 kJ/mol at the actual mM / 10 mM activities) and the aldehyde route (formate + H2 -> formaldehyde, +28 kJ/mol; [CH2O]eq = 3e-10 M). The universe is dissipative (0.88 W/L) but its flux is C1 reduction and pyruvate decay. Artifact: artifacts/motif_enrichment.json (arm phase1_feed).

findings.statement: With 10 mM formaldehyde added to the same feed, exactly one persistent autocatalytic motif emerges from the rules and is recovered post hoc: glycolaldehyde + CH2O -> glyceraldehyde -> dihydroxyacetone (+ CH2O) -> erythrulose -> erythrose -> 2 glycolaldehyde — the formose cycle (stoichiometric gain 2, dynamic gain 3.1 > 1, core of 5 species, 49 persistent species). 0 of 24 degree-preserving, (C,O)-matched null networks contain any motif: empirical p = 0.040 (1/25). The 6x6 ignition map (0.1-30 mM CH2O x 0.001-0.2/s washout; 3 nulls per cell, all 0) shows the motif only at formaldehyde >= 9.6 mM with washout >= 0.024/s, or 30 mM with washout >= 0.008/s (dynamic gain up to 18): at longer residence times the H2 reduction of formaldehyde and glycolaldehyde (k_reduce [H2] = 0.1/s) outruns the aldol propagation, and the gain falls below 1 again at 0.2/s where washout wins.

evidence.observed: universe 1 motif (gain 2, dynamic 3.1); nulls 0/24; p = 0.040; curated 1 motif (imposed)

findings.explanation: No rule names a cycle; the detector enumerates flux-carrying simple cycles with stoichiometric gain > 1 (Blokhuis 2020 type-I cores) from the doubling edges, identically for every class. The formose cycle closes through the retro-aldol of erythrose (the only doubling edge the chemistry provides at C <= 4). Artifact: artifacts/motif_enrichment.json (arm formose_feed, ignition_map).

findings.statement: Graded by the same detector, og-02's curated rTCA class shows one motif — the self-loop OAA + 2 CO2 -> 2 OAA + acetate — with dynamic gain 2.99, exactly its declared k_rtca [CO2] / k_wash, so the og-02 "autocatalytic gain" was a property written into the network, not an emergent one. The element ledger over its SBML finds the lumped turn creates 4 C, 8 H and 3 O per turn (6 C in, 10 C out), so og-02's net carbon throughput (6e-4 mol/s) counts carbon that was never fed. The curated class remains the fastest and richest in product, and the least conserving, of the three.

evidence.observed: element residual C 4 / H 8 / O 3 (max 8); detector gain 2.99 = declared 2.99

findings.explanation: og-02's finding og02-autocatalysis already said the motif was a curated lumped reaction; this study makes the consequence quantitative and machine-witnessed. The curated result keeps its PASS in og-02 (its gates do not include conservation) but is reclassed here as the imposed class.

findings.statement: Numerical verification: the universe is element-balanced by construction (max|E S| = 0 over 413 reactions, exact), the integrated carbon balance closes to 2.8e-6 (CVODE rtol 1e-6), dissipation -sum v dG is non-negative on every tick (0.88 W/L at the Phase-1 feed, 16 W/L in the formose arm), the MCA summation theorem holds to 3.3e-3 on the six dominant fluxes (1.3e-4 on the curated model), the Jacobian stiffness ratio is 9.4e2 (universe) / 4.8e3 (null), and tightening the tolerances to rtol 1e-9 changes no species by more than 7e-6 relative (loosening to 1e-3 changes the worst by 2.8e-3). The (C,O)-matched nulls fail the element ledger on hydrogen (residual 8-12) by construction.

evidence.observed: element 0; carbon 2.8e-6; dissipation_min >= 0; FCC summation 3.3e-3; tol sensitivity 7.0e-6

findings.explanation: Kinetics use the exergonic-direction class rate (k_down = k0, k_up = k0 exp(-|dG'0|/RT)), so detailed balance holds exactly and no rate exceeds a catalyst's turnover; the dissipation witness is therefore a real second-law check, not an identity. Artifacts: artifacts/reaction_universe_verification.json; the canonical run's ledger/* readouts.

findings.statement: The vg-data package reaction_universe carries 0 measured, 2 calibrated (the Phase-1 posterior feeds), 4 inferred, 7 extrapolated and 8 hypothetical parameters: every rate constant is an order-of-magnitude tick-scale number with a loguniform prior, swept rather than fitted. 50 of 121 skeletons resolve to a formula-verified KEGG compound and carry the live eQuilibrator component-contribution dG' (reaction dG' reproduced to 1e-6 kJ/mol); the other 71 carry a group-additivity estimate fitted to those (leave-one-out RMSE 7.2 kJ/mol).

evidence.observed: audit counts measured 0 / calibrated 2 / inferred 4 / extrapolated 7 / hypothetical 8; 50 resolved, 71 estimated

findings.explanation: The package is the honesty indicator the Model Upgrade plan asks for; its weakest entries are the rule rate constants, which is why the result is reported as an ignition region rather than a point.

conclusion: The generated universe at the vent posterior feed has no autocatalytic motif; with the formose feedstock one emerges post hoc and is enriched over matched nulls (p = 0.04); the curated rTCA motif is imposed and its lumped turn is not element-balanced; the universe's ledger closes exactly.

biological_validation.basis: Recovers the formose cycle (Breslow 1959) from rules alone and finds it enriched over nulls; no claim that the vent makes formaldehyde — the Phase-1 feed arm is a negative result.

explanatory_gain.basis: Explains WHY autocatalysis did not arise (every C-C route is uphill at vent activities), locates the ignition region (formaldehyde x residence time), and reclasses og-02's motif as imposed with a quantified conservation violation.

limitations.Linear carbon skeletons (no branched aci: the rTCA proper cannot close in this representation.

limitations: Rate constants are tick-scale hypothetical/extrapolated with loguniform priors that were not propagated (nominal + one 6x6 map only).
24 nulls per arm (p floor 0.04); nulls are (C,O)-matched so they violate H balance by construction (mean residual 9.6 atoms).

limitations.The nulls match compound count, reaction: their dG' are recomputed from the same compound potentials to keep them thermodynamically consistent, which widens the span to 714 kJ/mol (universe 166). A span-matched null would have to break detailed balance.

limitations: Catalyst crowding updated once per tick (operator splitting); dG' potentials fixed at the Phase-1 example condition (pH 9.38, I 0.25 M, 322 K).
The curated class publishes no ledger witnesses in the composite; its element residual is computed post hoc from its SBML.

resolved_uncertainties: og-02's autocatalytic gain was imposed by the lumped reaction; a rule-generated network with real dG' reproduces its reductive branch but not its motif.
The C <= 4 C/H/O rule set contains exactly one closable autocatalytic cycle (formose), and it is enriched over matched nulls when fed formaldehyde.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether co-localization (Phase 4) raises formate / glycolaldehyde activities enough to make the reductive-carboxylation routes downhill.
Whether N/P-bearing rules (og-res-N / og-res-P folded in) or branched skeletons (citrate) open rTCA-type cycles.
How the ignition region moves under the rate-constant priors (Sobol on the package).

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Propagate the reaction_universe priors (LHS over the 15 free rate constants) through both arms and report the posterior ignition fraction per class; add branched C5/C6 skeletons.
Feed the Phase-4 co-localized concentrations into the universe and ask whether the C1 -> C2 bottleneck opens (the flagship chain).

decisions_needed.question: Rule-set scope for the reaction universe: keep C1-C3 feedstock / C/H/O only (this PR, products capped at C4), or include N/P-bearing reactions from the start by folding the og-res-N and og-res-P resource chemistries into the universe (amines / nitriles / phosphorylation rules, N/P ledgers)?
decisions_needed.context: Defaulted to C1-C3 / C/H/O here so the first discriminating result rests on the best-constrained thermodynamics (eQuilibrator covers the C/H/O catalogue; the matched nulls stay (C,O)-balanced). Adding N/P multiplies the skeleton space, needs N/P potentials and a redesigned null, and would let amino-acid / nucleotide-precursor motifs compete with formose. Expert decision.

baseline.name: Open chemical network — reaction_universe at the Phase-1 feed

key_assumptions: Linear C/H/O skeletons up to C4; eleven reaction rules (H2 reductions, enol / reductive carboxylation, formose initiation, aldol, isomerisation, alpha/beta decarboxylation, Cannizzaro); every reaction reversible with k_down = k0 (rule class) and k_up = k0 exp(-|dG'0|/RT).
dG' potentials at pH 9.38 / I 0.25 M / 322 K (the Phase-1 posterior example point); water activity 1; CO2 and H2 vent-buffered, organics as CSTR inflow.
Catalyst classes (mineral: reductions / carboxylations; base: aldol / isomerisation / Cannizzaro) share a finite site pool f = sites / (1 + load / K_sat), updated per tick.
Null = degree-preserving swaps of organic species within (C, O)-count classes; dG' recomputed from the same potentials; same exchange / degradation reactions.

A persistent autocatalytic motif = a simple cycle of flux-carrying reactions (|v| > 1e-12 M/s, species > 1e-9 M) with stoichiometric gain > 1 (Blokhuis 2020 type-I core); currency species CO2 / H2 / H2O excluded as cycle members.
expert_questions: Rule-set scope — C1-C3 / C/H/O only (this build) or N/P-bearing rules from the start (see decisions_needed)?
Are the exergonic-direction class rates (k_down = k0) the right kinetic convention, or should the rule k0 be read as a Brønsted-Evans-Polanyi pre-factor with a transfer coefficient?
Is the formose arm (10 mM formaldehyde) a legitimate vent feedstock question, or should Phase 4 co-localization be the only route to raising C1 activities?
